quests.title: Chapter 0: Fall
quests.summary: A rookie commander crash-lands on the surface on his first mission and is saved by the Nikke Marian.
quests.start: Available from the start of the game.

quests.title: Chapter 1: Corruption
quests.summary: The commander takes charge of Rapi, Anis and Marian on a search-and-rescue mission that goes badly wrong.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 0 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 2: Identification
quests.summary: Now leading Counters, the commander is sent to check a power station on the surface for Deputy Chief Andersen.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 1 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 3: Enlightenment
quests.summary: Counters joins Syuen's squad Wardress on an off-the-books hunt for an unusually smart Rapture called Chatterbox.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 2 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 4: Bouquet
quests.summary: The secret operation to capture Chatterbox with Wardress continues, ending in an encounter with a mysterious rescuer.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 3 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

parts.title: The Ties That Bind Briefly: A
The Ties That Bind Briefly: B

quests.title: Chapter 5: Wonderland
quests.summary: Looking for answers about Marian, the commander heads to a snowy northern research base in search of a Pilgrim.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 4 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 6: Pilgrim
quests.summary: With data from the research base, Counters tracks the Pilgrim codenamed Snow White.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 5 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 7: Reunited
quests.summary: The commander travels with Snow White to corner Chatterbox and face the Heretic Modernia.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 6 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 8: Conflict
quests.summary: Counters looks for a way to read the strange bullet Snow White gave the commander, with help from Exia.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 7 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 9: Secret
quests.summary: Counters and Exia reach the old facility to scan the Vapaus bullet, and rival squads get involved.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 8 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 10: Comrade
quests.summary: Counters and Absolute are sent to Area H on a joint operation to collect Heretic fragments.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 9 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 11: The Strongest
quests.summary: The Area H operation continues as Syuen sends Matis to join, much to everyone's annoyance.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 10 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 12: Hometown
quests.summary: Cut off from the others, the commander, Rapi and Matis must escape a deadly underground Rapture base.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 11 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

parts.title: In the Belly of the Beast

quests.title: Chapter 13: Comeback
quests.summary: The Big Three launch an all-out assault on the Heretic Modernia, and the commander joins with a plan of his own.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 12 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 14: Journey
quests.summary: Marian joins Counters at last, but several factions want to take her away.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 13 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 15: Luck
quests.summary: Short on funds to repair the Outpost, Counters takes an escort job with the squad Talentum.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 14 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 16: Brand
quests.summary: Counters heads north on a joint mission with Exotic, a squad of unruly convicts, to find the Pilgrims.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 15 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 17: Purpose
quests.summary: Left for dead, the commander is rescued by the Pilgrim Rapunzel and travels with her squad.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 16 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 18: Hero
quests.summary: Syuen sends Counters and Matis on a staged rescue meant to win back public trust in Matis.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 17 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 19: Eden
quests.summary: Counters searches for a facility that made Vapaus and meets a new squad of Pilgrims.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 18 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 20: Flame Dragon
quests.summary: Counters and the squad Inherit are sent to take down the Heretic Nihilister.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 19 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 21: Giant Whale
quests.summary: To make Vapaus, Counters has to bring down Mother Whale, a gigantic Tyrant-class Rapture.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 20 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

parts.title: First Encounter with a Colleague: A
First Encounter with a Colleague: B

quests.title: Chapter 22: Invasion
quests.summary: Returning home, Counters finds Raptures loose inside the Ark itself.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 21 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 23: Prison
quests.summary: The Rapture attack on the Ark continues as the Big Three and Counters work out who is behind it.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 22 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 24: Banishment
quests.summary: The Ark scrambles to contain the crisis while a worse threat takes shape.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 23 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 25: Tracking
quests.summary: With the Ark safe, Counters returns to the surface to search for a lost comrade.

quests.title: Chapter 26: Return
quests.summary: Counters is stunned by what has happened to a friend and sets out to fix it.

quests.summary: Counters explores the newly reached Crystal Region alongside new companions.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 26 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 29: Rescue
quests.summary: Separated from their support team, Counters and the others search for their missing members.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 28 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 30: Treasure
quests.summary: The search for the missing squadmates turns up truths about the world and its people.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 29 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 31: Mabeast
quests.summary: Counters returns to the Crystal Region with Absolute to find Grave and stop the Heretic Anachiro.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 30 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 32: Advance
quests.summary: The group tries to revive a sleeping Heretic, which means getting past dangerous foes.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 31 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 33: Clash
quests.summary: Counters sets out to eliminate the Heretic Behemoth.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 32 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 34: Inheritance
quests.summary: Reinforced by an upgraded Absolute, Counters tries to finish the fight with the Four Beasts' Behemoth.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 33 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 35: Conversation
quests.summary: Back in the Ark, Counters prepares for its next target: capturing Leviathan.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 34 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 36: Betrayal
quests.summary: The commander questions the captured Leviathan about the Heretics' plans.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 35 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 37: Struggle
quests.summary: Talks with Leviathan go wrong, and the commander pushes deeper with the squad Aegis.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 36 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 38: Gluttony
quests.summary: The group runs into a Tyrant-class Rapture driven to devour everything in its path.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 37 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

quests.title: Chapter 39: Gene
quests.summary: The commander, Rapi and Matis board a white Mother Whale, while Anis and Neon plan a farewell concert.
quests.start: Clear Chapter 38 in the Campaign (Normal or Story Mode).

parts.title: The Light that Illuminates the Stars

parts.title: The Voices that Reach the Star

quests.title: Chapter 42: Only One
